The 2025 budget’s $880B Medicaid cuts threaten millions—kids, seniors, disabled—who rely on care. Fraud’s real but small (8.6% improper payments, mostly errors). Undocumented immigrants cost Medicaid ~$6.5B/yr (emergency & state programs) they’re ineligible. Don’t slash coverage for legit quality people to fix this! Smart reforms can stop free riders while saving eligible folks in CA, NY, PA, AZ, CO, VA, NE:
1.  Real-Time Audits: Use IRS/SSA data matching to verify income & identity, catching fraud (e.g., fake SSNs) without disenrolling kids or disabled. California’s AI pilots cut errors 30%.
2.  AI Fraud Detection: Predictive analytics flag suspicious claims (e.g., $4M Florida fraud case), targeting abuse, not honest enrollees.
3.  Auto-Renewals: Automate eligibility via tax/SNAP data, preventing 70% of 2023-24 unwinding losses due to paperwork. Washington saved millions.
4.  Value-Based Care: Pay providers for outcomes (e.g., fewer hospitalizations), saving billions like NY’s model, not cutting benefits.
5.  Flexible FMAP: Adjust federal matching to reward states for anti-fraud tech, not force coverage cuts. Protects rural hospitals.
6.  Public Oversight: Bipartisan audits & hearings ensure cuts don’t harm your constituents. Transparency builds trust.
Per capita caps & work requirements risk 15.9M uninsured—don’t do it! Valadao, Malliotakis, Ciscomani, Bresnahan, Hurd—you opposed deep cuts; hold firm in reconciliation.
